mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lab_item_statistics WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND dept_code = #{deptCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_item_statistics (item_id, dept_code, sample_count, mean_value, std_deviation, min_value, max_value, update_time) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{deptCode}, #{sampleCount}, #{meanValue}, #{stdDeviation}, #{minValue}, #{maxValue}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sample_count = VALUES(sample_count), mean_value = VALUES(mean_value), std_deviation = VALUES(std_deviation), min_value = VALUES(min_value), max_value = VALUES(max_value), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
